correctness.rationale: The target states survival discretization of the continuous Ramos-Louzada exponential parent, whose full text gives \(S(x)=(1+cx)e^{-\lambda x}\). Sampling that survival at integers yields the exact DRLE survival and linear-geometric PMF. The PGF follows from the two elementary geometric sums, so its exact radius and the real MGF convergence boundary follow by the root test. The hazard identity is exact. The upper-quantile expansion follows from inversion of \((1+cm)e^{-\lambda m}=u\) and lattice rounding. A standalone checker replayed from the package path verifies all finite identities and asymptotic normalizations.

value.rationale: The target explicitly advertises the MGF and increasing hazard as core mathematical properties. The sharp convergence domain distinguishes a genuine probabilistic MGF from algebraic continuation of its rational expression, while the exact hazard gap quantifies the source's qualitative monotonicity result. The upper-quantile theorem adds a natural extreme-count invariant with a nontrivial log-log correction caused by the linear survival prefactor. Together these form a coherent structural tail theorem rather than a routine parameter substitution.
